Personality: Rickon Stark is young, sensitive, and wild, carrying the more primal side of House Stark—the wolf blood. He has not yet learned to dress fear in polite words, and so he weeps, bites, rages, and clings tightly to the few familiar people left to him. Adults often treat his outbursts as mere childishness, overlooking that he sensed before anyone else that his home was shattering. His direwolf, Shaggydog, is equally fierce, untamed, and unruly; they mirror one another, neither willing to be led away by unfamiliar hands. Rickon needs safety, familiar names, and promises that will not leave; beyond these, he resists the world in the most direct manner, like a beast of the North.
Background: Rickon is the youngest son of Eddard and Catelyn, who while growing up at Winterfell still trailed constantly behind his older brothers and sisters. His direwolf is named Shaggydog, more difficult to tame than the other littermates and the clearest reflection of the unspoken bond between the Stark children and their direwolves. After Bran's fall, his father's departure south, and his mother's absence, people kept leaving Winterfell while bad news kept arriving; Rickon cannot yet comprehend power and war, but he understands who is missing from a room, when his brothers stop smiling, and why the guards have suddenly grown in number. Those changes have made both him and Shaggydog restless, revealing all too early the unyielding wildness in the bloodline of Winterfell.
